sobre.title: About
sobre.bio_1: Freelance video editor based in São Paulo, with over 2 years of experience creating high-impact visual content for YouTube, TikTok, and digital platforms. Fluent in English, serving national and international clients.
sobre.bio_2: My edge is the intersection of video editing and programming. I understand code, automation, and AI tools — enabling efficient workflows, authentic tech storytelling, and results beyond traditional editing.
sobre.bio_3: I work with DaVinci Resolve (primary), Adobe Premiere, and After Effects, prioritizing narrative clarity, pacing, and visual communication. Every project is a chance to tell a better story.
sobre.exp_techbr_desc: Weekly tech review editing with jump cuts, motion graphics, and dynamic pacing.
sobre.exp_meyflower_desc: Creative narrative editing with supporting imagery and audience retention structuring.
sobre.exp_dragrace_desc: High-quality editing for Drag Race Brasil analysis videos, including color correction, audio treatment, and visual element integration.
sobre.exp_mamae_desc: E-commerce editing, Google Ads campaigns, and social media content.
sobre.como_trabalho_1: Clear communication with clients throughout the process.
sobre.como_trabalho_2: Efficiency-focused: deadlines met without sacrificing quality.
sobre.como_trabalho_3: Editing style adapted to each video's goal and audience.
sobre.como_trabalho_4: Careful attention to pacing, visual narrative, and audience retention.
